def gui_loop(slp=0):
    """
    Execute the main loop for the GUI until all the current events are processed
    """
    start = time.time()
    app = wx.GetApp()
    if app is None:
        return

    while time.time() < (start + slp):
        wx.CallAfter(app.ExitMainLoop)
        app.MainLoop()
